name: io.onchaingambler/casinos
title: OnchainGambler: crypto casino data
description: Compare crypto casinos by token, chain and KYC, with house edge, safeguards and incident warnings.

tools.name: find_casinos
tools.description: Search the OnchainGambler.io index of crypto casinos. Filter by accepted token (symbol or name, e.g. 'USDT', 'Solana'), blockchain, KYC level, feature and confirmed player protections (self-exclusion, limits), optionally leaving out casinos with warnings. Each result carries its `warning` (caution or high) and incidents. Results are sorted by editorial rating.

kyc.description: none = no verification, light = verification only if triggered, full = always required

selfExclusion.description: true = only casinos whose own pages confirm both temporary and permanent self-exclusion

limits.description: true = only casinos whose own pages confirm deposit, loss or wager limits, or casino or sports exclusion (see protections.limits.note for which)

excludeWarnings.description: high = leave out casinos under a high warning; any = leave out every casino with a warning (caution or high). See list_incidents for the policy

tools.name: get_casino
tools.description: Full data sheet for one casino: rating, KYC policy, license, accepted tokens and chains, features, bonus, pros and cons, plus researched KYC triggers, originals house edge and player protections (provably fair, verification guide, self-exclusion, limits, help resources, 24/7 support, RTP disclosure) with sources, and incidents (hacks, regulator and legal actions, withheld-funds reports) with any caution or high warning.

casino.description: Casino slug, id or name, e.g. 'stake-com' or 'Stake'

tools.name: compare_casinos
tools.description: Head-to-head comparison of two casinos across rating, privacy, token and chain coverage, features and track record.

a.description: First casino slug, id or name

b.description: Second casino slug, id or name

tools.name: list_options
tools.description: Lists the tokens, blockchains, KYC levels and features that can be used as filters.

tools.name: list_house_edges
tools.description: House edge of crypto casinos' in-house originals (dice, crash, plinko, ...): the advertised figure next to any independent check, with status (advertised, community-verified, disputed) and source links. Also lists 0% edge offers and their conditions.

casino.description: Casino slug, id or name to filter by

game.description: Game name to filter by, e.g. 'Crash' or 'Dice'

tools.name: list_incidents
tools.description: Incidents on record across the index, newest first: hacks, regulator and legal actions, withheld-funds reports, operator and licence changes, game-fairness disputes. Each has a status (confirmed, alleged, resolved) and source links; player complaints are allegations. Also returns the casinos under a caution or high warning and the policy that sets the level.

casino.description: Casino slug, id or name to filter by

since.description: Only incidents in or after this month, 'YYYY-MM'

until.description: Only incidents in or before this month, 'YYYY-MM'; with since, a time window (since 2026-01 until 2026-12 = all of 2026)

warning.description: high = only casinos under a high warning; any = only casinos under a caution or high warning
